privacyNoCollectionBody.before:
근무 스케줄, 알람 설정과 알람 기록, 메모/일정, 근무시간·OT, 수면 기록, 친구 목록 등 앱에서 만드는 데이터는 사용자의 기기 안에 저장되며 개발자에게 전송되지 않습니다. 자동 수면 추정도 화면이 켜져 있는지, 충전 중인지만 기기 안에서 확인하고 그 결과를 밖으로 보내지 않습니다.

다만 아래 '사용 통계', '일정공유', '광고' 항목에 적힌 범위의 정보는 Google 서비스로 전송됩니다.

진단 파일은 Android 10 이상에서 기기 안의 Download/ShiftBell/log 폴더에 자동 저장·갱신됩니다. 이 파일에는 기기·Android 버전, 권한과 배터리 설정 상태, 알람 예약·울림 기록, 백업 기록이 들어가며 메모·일정 내용, 근무명, 친구 이름은 들어가지 않아요. 앱이 이 파일을 자동으로 전송하지 않으며, 필요할 때 사용자가 직접 찾아 보내실 수 있어요.

설정 → 부가 기능 → 진단 로그 이메일로 보내기를 누르면 공유용 .txt 파일을 앱의 임시 폴더에 만듭니다. 전송은 사용자가 메일 앱에서 직접 완료합니다. 이메일로 보내면 로그 파일, 메일에 적은 내용과 발신자 이메일 주소가 개발자에게 전달됩니다. 교대시계는 이메일 계정 정보에 접근하거나 로그를 자동 전송하지 않습니다.

privacyDataRetentionBody.before:
기기 안의 데이터는 앱을 삭제하면 함께 삭제됩니다.

단, '백업' 기능(자동 백업 포함)으로 만든 파일은 기기의 다운로드/ShiftBell 폴더에 남아 앱을 삭제해도 지워지지 않습니다. 이 파일은 암호화되지 않았고 근무표·알람 기록·메모/일정·OT·수면 기록·친구 목록 등이 들어 있으니 다른 사람에게 보내지 않도록 주의하고, 필요 없으면 파일 관리자에서 직접 삭제해 주세요. 백업 파일은 자동으로 외부에 전송되지 않지만, 클라우드 동기화 폴더 등으로 옮기면 그 서비스의 정책이 적용됩니다.

Download/ShiftBell/log의 진단 파일도 앱 삭제 후 남을 수 있습니다. 이 파일에는 기기 정보, 권한 상태, 알람·백업 기록이 들어 있으므로 필요 없으면 파일 관리자에서 직접 삭제해 주세요.

백업은 Android 10 이상에서만 지원됩니다. 앱을 삭제하고 다시 설치하면 이전 백업을 자동으로 찾지 못하므로, 첫 화면의 '기존에 쓰시던 분이라면'에서 '불러오기'를 눌러 파일을 직접 골라야 합니다.

일정공유 데이터의 삭제는 위 '일정공유' 안내를, 사용 통계·광고 데이터의 보관은 Google의 정책을 따릅니다.

helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.before:
가장 먼저 설정에서 이 앱의 알림·정확한 알람·다른 앱 위에 표시 권한이 켜져 있는지, 배터리 최적화 대상에서 제외돼 있는지 확인하세요. 그다음 그 날짜에 근무가 배정돼 있는지, 그 근무에 고정 알람이 등록돼 있는지도 확인해보세요.

교대시계 앱의 설정 → 알람 권한 설정에서 잠금화면 표시를 포함한 각 권한을 확인해 주세요. 설정을 마친 뒤 앱으로 돌아오세요. 첫 설정 중에는 준비가 되면 다음을 눌러 주세요.
helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.after:
1. 권한과 휴대폰 설정 확인
설정 → 알람 권한 설정에서 알림, 정확한 알람, 잠금화면 표시, 다른 앱 위에 표시 권한을 확인해 주세요.

휴대폰 설정 → 앱 → 교대시계 → 배터리에서 백그라운드 사용이 제한되어 있지 않은지도 확인해 주세요.

2. 근무와 고정 알람 확인
달력에서 해당 날짜에 근무가 배정되어 있는지 확인하세요. 설정 → 편집 → 고정 알람 수정에서 그 근무에 알람이 등록되어 있는지도 확인해 주세요. 근무만 배정하고 알람을 등록하지 않으면 알람은 울리지 않습니다.

3. 제조사별 알람 동작
Samsung, Motorola, OPPO, Xiaomi, Google Pixel, realme의 검증 기기에서는 필요한 권한을 설정한 환경에서 정상적인 알람 동작을 확인했습니다.

그 외 제조사의 기기는 권한을 모두 허용해도 알람이 울리지 않거나 정확한 시간에 작동하지 않을 수 있습니다. 검증 제조사를 늘리고 알람 신뢰도를 높이는 작업을 계속하고 있습니다.

4. 문제가 계속된다면
기기명, Android 버전, 문제가 발생한 시간을 적어 개발자 이메일 lowvibe07@gmail.com으로 연락해 주세요. 설정 → 부가 기능 → 진단 로그 이메일로 보내기에서 로그 파일을 함께 보내면 원인 확인에 도움이 됩니다.

privacyNoCollectionBody.before:
Your shifts, alarm settings and history, notes, work hours and overtime are stored in the app’s local database. These contents are not included in analytics events or advertising requests.

On Android 10 or later, diagnostic files are saved locally in Download/ShiftBell/log. They include device and Android versions, permission and battery settings, and alarm and backup processing records. Note contents and shift names are excluded. The app does not send these files automatically.
privacyNoCollectionBody.after:
Your shifts, alarm settings and history, notes, work hours and overtime are stored in the app’s local database. These contents are not included in analytics events or advertising requests.

On Android 10 or later, diagnostic files are saved locally in Download/ShiftBell/log. They include device and Android versions, permission and battery settings, and alarm and backup processing records. Note contents and shift names are excluded. The app does not send these files automatically.

Settings → Additional features → Email diagnostic log creates a .txt attachment in the app’s temporary folder. You complete sending in your email app. Sending an email gives the developer the log file, the message you write and your sender email address. ShiftBell does not access your email account information or send logs automatically.

privacyDataRetentionBody.before:
Uninstalling removes the app’s local database. Backup and diagnostic files saved in Download/ShiftBell may remain; delete them with your file manager when they are no longer needed.

Backups are not encrypted. They can contain your full local data. Keep them private. The app never uploads these files automatically. If you copy them to a cloud service or send them to someone, that service or recipient controls the copy.

The app keeps one manual backup and one automatic backup. A new file replaces the previous file of the same kind.

Google’s policies apply to retention of analytics and advertising data.
privacyDataRetentionBody.after:
Uninstalling removes the app’s local database. Backup and diagnostic files saved in Download/ShiftBell may remain; delete them with your file manager when they are no longer needed.

Backups are not encrypted. They can contain your full local data. Keep them private. The app never uploads these files automatically. If you copy them to a cloud service or send them to someone, that service or recipient controls the copy.

The app keeps one manual backup and one automatic backup. A new file replaces the previous file of the same kind.

Google’s policies apply to retention of analytics and advertising data.

Diagnostic attachments in the app’s temporary folder are removed when the app is uninstalled. Copies you send through email or another app are retained by that service and the recipient.

helpBackupAutoBackupBody.before:
ShiftBell checks for changes when you open, return to or leave the app. If your data has changed, it saves an automatic backup to Download/ShiftBell on your device. You can also choose Back up data in Settings.

It keeps one manual backup and one automatic backup. A new backup replaces only the file of the same kind. Backups require Android 10 or later.
helpBackupAutoBackupBody.after:

helpBackupRestoreBody.before:
Choose Restore from backup on the first screen or in Settings, then select a backup file from Download/ShiftBell. Review its saved time before restoring: it replaces your schedule, notes, overtime and other saved data and settings.

Alarm history and creation records are merged with the backup. Alarms that are ringing or snoozed are kept.

To move to another phone, copy the file to that phone first. After restoring, check your shifts, upcoming alarms and alarm permissions.
helpBackupRestoreBody.after:
On the first screen, choose Restore from backup. You can also use Settings → Additional features → Data backup → Restore from backup. Select a file from Download/ShiftBell and review its saved time: restoring replaces your schedule, notes, overtime and other saved data and settings.

Alarm history and creation records are merged with the backup. Alarms that are ringing or snoozed are kept.

To move to another phone, copy the file to that phone first. After restoring, check your shifts, upcoming alarms and alarm permissions.

helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.before:
Check exact alarm permission, notification and display-over-other-apps permissions, and your phone’s battery restrictions. Then check that the date has a shift assigned, that the shift has an alarm, and that sound or vibration is enabled.

Open Settings → Alarm permissions in ShiftBell to check each permission, including lock screen display. Return to the app after changing settings. During first setup, tap Next when you are ready.
helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.after:
1. Check permissions and phone settings
Open Settings → Alarm permissions and check notifications, exact alarms, lock screen display and display over other apps.

Also check Phone settings → Apps → ShiftBell → Battery for restrictions on background use.

2. Check shifts and shift alarms
Check that a shift is assigned to the date in the calendar. In Settings → Edit → Edit Shift Alarms, check that an alarm is set for that shift. Assigning a shift alone does not create an alarm if no shift alarm has been set.

3. Alarm operation by manufacturer
On the Samsung, Motorola, OPPO, Xiaomi, Google Pixel and realme devices we checked, we confirmed normal alarm operation with the required permissions configured.

On devices from other manufacturers, alarms may fail to ring or may not run at the scheduled time even when permissions are allowed. We are expanding manufacturer verification and continuing to improve alarm reliability.

4. If the problem continues
Contact the developer at lowvibe07@gmail.com with your device model, Android version and the time of the problem. You can also attach a log using Settings → Additional features → Email diagnostic log to help identify the cause.

helpTroubleshootBackupFileMissingBody.before: Look in Download/ShiftBell using your phone’s file manager. If no backup is there, use Back up data in Settings to create one.
helpTroubleshootBackupFileMissingBody.after: Look in Download/ShiftBell using your phone’s file manager. If no backup is there, create one using Settings → Additional features → Data backup → Save backup.

They include device and Android versions, permission and battery settings, and alarm and backup processing records. Note contents and shift names are excluded. Files are not sent automatically. You can attach them when contacting support. They may remain after uninstalling; remove them in your file manager when no longer needed.

Use Settings → Additional features → Email diagnostic log to send a .txt file to the developer. Choose your sending account in your email app and complete sending there. The recipient is lowvibe07@gmail.com.

On Android 10 or later, you can also find automatically saved diagnostic files in Download/ShiftBell/log using your file manager.

They include device and Android versions, permission and battery settings, and alarm and backup processing records. Note contents and shift names are excluded. Files are not sent automatically. You can attach them when contacting support. They may remain after uninstalling; remove them in your file manager when no longer needed.

Für einen Gerätewechsel kopierst du die Datei zuerst auf das neue Handy. Prüfe nach der Wiederherstellung Schichten, kommende Wecker und Weckerberechtigungen.

helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.before:
Prüfe die Berechtigungen für genaue Alarme, Benachrichtigungen und das Einblenden über anderen Apps sowie die Akkubeschränkungen deines Handys. Dem Tag muss eine Schicht mit einem Wecker zugewiesen sein. Kontrolliere auch, ob Ton oder Vibration eingeschaltet ist.

Öffne Einstellungen → Weckerberechtigungen in ShiftBell und prüfe jede Berechtigung, auch für den Sperrbildschirm. Kehre nach dem Einstellen zur App zurück. Tippe bei der ersten Einrichtung anschließend auf Weiter.
helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.after:
1. Berechtigungen und Handyeinstellungen prüfen
Öffne Einstellungen → Weckerberechtigungen und prüfe Benachrichtigungen, genaue Wecker, die Anzeige auf dem Sperrbildschirm und die Anzeige über anderen Apps.

Prüfe außerdem unter Handyeinstellungen → Apps → ShiftBell → Akku, ob die Nutzung im Hintergrund eingeschränkt ist.

2. Schichten und Schichtwecker prüfen
Prüfe im Kalender, ob dem Datum eine Schicht zugeordnet ist. Unter Einstellungen → Bearbeiten → Schichtwecker bearbeiten kannst du prüfen, ob für diese Schicht ein Wecker eingerichtet ist. Eine zugeordnete Schicht allein löst ohne eingerichteten Schichtwecker keinen Wecker aus.

3. Weckerfunktion je nach Hersteller
Auf den von uns geprüften Geräten von Samsung, Motorola, OPPO, Xiaomi, Google Pixel und realme haben wir bei eingerichteten erforderlichen Berechtigungen eine normale Weckerfunktion bestätigt.

Bei Geräten anderer Hersteller kann ein Wecker trotz erlaubter Berechtigungen ausbleiben oder nicht zur geplanten Zeit ausgelöst werden. Wir erweitern die Herstellerprüfung und arbeiten weiter an der Zuverlässigkeit der Wecker.

4. Wenn das Problem weiterhin auftritt
Schreibe dem Entwickler an lowvibe07@gmail.com und nenne Gerätemodell, Android-Version und den Zeitpunkt des Problems. Unter Einstellungen → Zusätzliche Funktionen → Diagnoseprotokoll per E-Mail senden kannst du ein Protokoll anhängen, das bei der Ursachenklärung hilft.

helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.before:
Confira as permissões de alarmes exatos, notificações e exibição sobre outros apps, além das restrições de bateria do aparelho. Depois, verifique se a data tem um turno com alarme e se o som ou a vibração está ativado.

Abra Configurações → Permissões do alarme no ShiftBell para conferir cada permissão, incluindo a tela de bloqueio. Volte ao app após configurar. Na primeira configuração, toque em Avançar quando terminar.
helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.after:
1. Confira as permissões e configurações do celular
Abra Configurações → Permissões do alarme e confira notificações, alarmes exatos, exibição na tela de bloqueio e sobre outros apps.

Confira também se há restrições ao uso em segundo plano em Configurações do celular → Apps → ShiftBell → Bateria.

2. Confira os turnos e alarmes
Veja se há um turno atribuído à data no calendário. Em Configurações → Editar → Editar alarmes de turno, confira se há um alarme para esse turno. Atribuir um turno não faz o alarme tocar se nenhum alarme de turno estiver configurado.

3. Funcionamento por fabricante
Nos aparelhos Samsung, Motorola, OPPO, Xiaomi, Google Pixel e realme que verificamos, confirmamos o funcionamento normal dos alarmes com as permissões necessárias configuradas.

Em aparelhos de outros fabricantes, os alarmes podem não tocar ou não ser acionados no horário previsto, mesmo com as permissões concedidas. Continuamos ampliando a verificação de fabricantes e melhorando a confiabilidade dos alarmes.

4. Se o problema continuar
Entre em contato com o desenvolvedor pelo e-mail lowvibe07@gmail.com, informando modelo do aparelho, versão do Android e horário do problema. Você também pode anexar um log em Configurações → Recursos adicionais → Enviar log de diagnóstico por e-mail para ajudar a identificar a causa.

helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.before:
सटीक अलार्म, सूचनाओं और दूसरे ऐप्स के ऊपर दिखाने की अनुमतियां तथा फ़ोन की बैटरी पाबंदियां जांचें। फिर देखें कि उस तारीख पर शिफ्ट लगी है, शिफ्ट के लिए अलार्म है और आवाज़ या वाइब्रेशन चालू है।

ShiftBell में सेटिंग → अलार्म की अनुमतियाँ खोलकर हर अनुमति जांचें, जिसमें लॉक स्क्रीन पर दिखाना भी शामिल है। सेटिंग बदलने के बाद ऐप में वापस आएं। पहली बार सेट करते समय तैयार होने पर आगे पर टैप करें।
helpTroubleshootAlarmIssueBody.after:
1. अनुमतियां और फ़ोन की सेटिंग जांचें
सेटिंग → अलार्म की अनुमतियाँ में सूचनाएं, सटीक अलार्म, लॉक स्क्रीन पर दिखाना और दूसरे ऐप्स के ऊपर दिखाने की अनुमतियां जांचें।

फ़ोन की सेटिंग → ऐप्स → ShiftBell → बैटरी में यह भी देखें कि बैकग्राउंड इस्तेमाल पर पाबंदी तो नहीं है।

2. शिफ्ट और उसके अलार्म जांचें
कैलेंडर में देखें कि उस तारीख पर शिफ्ट दर्ज है। सेटिंग → बदलें → शिफ्ट के अलार्म बदलें में उस शिफ्ट के लिए अलार्म जांचें। सिर्फ शिफ्ट दर्ज करने से अलार्म नहीं बजेगा, जब तक उसके लिए अलार्म सेट न हो।

3. अलग-अलग निर्माताओं पर अलार्म
हमने Samsung, Motorola, OPPO, Xiaomi, Google Pixel और realme के जिन डिवाइस की जांच की है, उन पर ज़रूरी अनुमतियां सेट होने पर अलार्म का सामान्य रूप से काम करना पाया है।

दूसरे निर्माताओं के डिवाइस पर सभी अनुमतियां मिलने के बाद भी अलार्म नहीं बज सकता या तय समय पर नहीं चल सकता। हम और निर्माताओं के डिवाइस की जांच कर रहे हैं और अलार्म की भरोसेमंद कार्यप्रणाली सुधारते जा रहे हैं।

4. समस्या बनी रहे तो
डिवाइस मॉडल, Android संस्करण और समस्या का समय लिखकर डेवलपर को lowvibe07@gmail.com पर ईमेल करें। सेटिंग → अतिरिक्त सुविधाएँ → जांच का लॉग ईमेल से भेजें से लॉग फ़ाइल भी संलग्न कर सकते हैं, जिससे कारण पता लगाने में मदद मिलेगी.
